provenance.suite_shape: 324 scenarios / 10 subjects / 648 points in the declared space
provenance.caveat: Subjects are MUTANTS written alongside the verifier, so this is a lower bound on what the verifier detects and says nothing about difficulty for a real agent — no trial has been run. The application is simulated: a deterministic tree, not a browser, so a pass here does not transfer to a real DOM without further evidence. Isolation is in-process for this sweep.
